'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
